Our services

A complete suite of luxury

We offer professional photography services covering every detail of your event from start to finish.

Wedding photography

Complete documentation of your wedding day in a cinematic style that preserves every smile and tear of joy.

Engagement photography

Romantic sessions celebrating the start of your story with an elegant, unforgettable style.

Special occasions

Birthdays, graduations, family evenings — we capture the joy of every moment with great craftsmanship.

Christenings & church events

Christenings, first communions and family celebrations in church — photographed quietly and with respect for the setting.

Cinematic videography

Short films of cinematic quality that tell the story of your event with professional music and editing.

Aerial drone photography

Stunning aerial shots that give your event a luxurious visual dimension from unique angles.

How it works

From first message to finished photographs

Every occasion is different, which is why every quote is put together for you. Here is the path.

  1. 1

    Tell us about your occasion

    The date, the place and what you have in mind. A short message is enough to start.

  2. 2

    You get a tailored quote

    There is no fixed price list: scope, hours and delivery are set around your event, not a package someone else chose.

  3. 3

    We photograph the day

    We work quietly in the background, so nobody spends the day thinking about the camera.

  4. 4

    You receive the photographs

    Selected and edited, delivered digitally for you to share and print as you like.

About us

A team that sees beauty in every detail

At ELEGANTMEDIA studio, we believe every occasion has a unique soul that deserves to be immortalized in its most beautiful form. For over twelve years, we have accompanied families and couples through the most beautiful moments of their lives.

Our team brings together elite photographers, videographers and professional drone pilots. We work with the latest equipment and unwavering passion to deliver work that exceeds your expectations.

  • The latest professional cameras and lenses
  • Fast delivery and high-quality editing
  • Complete confidentiality and respect for your privacy
